result:
Both suites pass. Summary of the change:

- **`Documentation/examples/observations.txt`** is no longer committed (`git rm`), and added to `.gitignore` as a defensive measure since it can now be written transiently.
- **`crates/ucal/tests/json_surface.rs`** and **`crates/ucal/tests/manual_fields.rs`**: each test binary now writes the synthetic observations to its own temp file (keyed on process id *and* thread id, since the shared `commands()`/`all_commands()` helper is called concurrently from several `#[test]` fns on separate threads of the same process — plain pid-keying would reproduce the exact race the old committed-fixture comment describes) and removes it on drop.
- **`xtask/src/examples.rs`**: `generate()` (used by both `gen-examples` and `check-docs`) now writes the same synthetic observations to `Documentation/examples/observations.txt` for the duration of the run, via an `ObservationsFixture` drop guard, since that doc example's command line literally names that path.

Verified `cargo test -q -p ucal --no-fail-fast`, `cargo test -q -p xtask --no-fail-fast`, and (by temporarily pointing `target/release` at the actual build output, since this sandbox's `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` lives outside the tree) that `cargo run -p xtask -- check-docs` still reports the worked examples as matching. No commit was made, per your instructions.
